caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular window set in a recessed stone or stucco wall, with architectural details rendered in shades of light gray and beige. The window itself is bordered by a yellow and blue trim that follows the contour of the upper frame, which is arched and scalloped in shape. Above the window, there is a decorative garland of green leaves interspersed with red, blue, and yellow bell-shaped flowers, symmetrically hanging down both sides of the window. At the center-top of the garland is a small, winged cherub’s head with golden hair and light-colored wings. The background is mostly plain, with the focus remaining on the decorated window and its ornamental features. The drawing is signed "Edward T. Jewitt" at the bottom right corner.
title: Wall Painting
